entries.prompt_text:
Luminous high-detail digital painting in the manner of epic fantasy webcomic cover art: refined, beautiful, melancholic. Realistic adult proportions; elegant, delicate faces with calm or sorrowful restraint; long flowing hair, capes and fabric moved by wind; armour with fine engraved detail and soft metallic sheen. Painterly soft-edged rendering with selective crisp edges on faces and silhouettes; NO heavy cartoon ink outlines, no flat cel shading, no cute or childlike faces.
LIGHT IS THE SUBJECT: one dominant motivated light source (sun shaft through a high window, sunset, dawn, a lantern) glowing through haze; bloom and volumetric god rays; drifting light particles (embers, dust, sea spray, ash, petals) catching the light; deep atmospheric shadows; highlights reserved for faces, crown, blade and the one symbolic object. Cyan-green soulfire glows only on the undead; ivory-gold or natural sunset light on the living and the city.
POWER IN THE COMPOSITION: camera angle and placement state who holds power: low angles and elevated thrones for the ruler, figures dwarfed by vast architecture or sea, ranks of soldiers as repeating silhouettes fading into haze, the key figure isolated by light. Strong diagonals and depth: dark foreground silhouettes, midground figures, background receding into luminous atmosphere.
PALETTE: muted, desaturated cool shadows (ink-navy, sea-grey, slate) against warm or cyan light; one or two saturated accents (purple cape, crimson sash, gold crown).
NEGATIVE: ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT of any kind in the image: no titles, captions, letters, numbers, signatures, labels, banners with writing, inscriptions or UI. No chibi, no cute, no bright flat cartoon colours, no flat even lighting, no heavy black comic outlines, no centered snapshot composition, no text, no logos, no names of existing games, studios or artists.
FORMAT: epic ending key art, landscape 16:9 (2048x1152), cinematic composition, absolutely no text.
SCENE: A winter night in a plain market square of the white city after the Unending Day has gone out. Edmund, crowned, stands among ordinary living townsfolk handing out split firewood from a cart; braziers burn in the square; the windows around show ordinary scattered lamplight under a real starry sky. No papers, books, signs or banners anywhere.
POWER AND COMPOSITION: eye-level, crowded and human; the crown is the only gold in the scene; the king works shoulder to shoulder with commoners, a little apart because of what he is.
LIGHT: warm brazier and lamplight, real night sky with stars; his soulfire subdued.
WORLD RULES: The artificial Unending Day has been extinguished: there is NO ring of light, halo or second sun anywhere in the sky; only the natural night sky. There is no writing anywhere in the image. Undead glow cyan-green only; the living are lit by warm or natural light.
CHARACTERS (match the attached reference sheets for faces and costume): Edmund (undead prince)
REFERENCE IMAGES: attached are character sheets for identity and costume only; render in the epic painted style described above, not in the style of the sheets.
entries.selection_reason: 第三版共同劳作的构图最好，但仍不合格，保留在alt供Lead复核；不将失败版写入主图路径。

variants.note: 落选：无文字、无纸张，暖火与星夜成立；王子居中突出且有额外金色甲饰，观众右侧下颌未呈现露齿骷髅，断冠不清楚。
落选：无文字、无纸张，分柴动作清楚；王子比第一版更正面，但右侧口唇与下颌仍近人脸，额外金色胸甲饰纹明显。
最佳落选：左侧平民协作、右侧母女接柴，最符合共同劳作的叙事；仍缺完整骷髅半脸、清楚断冠，甲饰存在额外金色。

checklist.requirement: 没有任何文字、字母、签名、题字
checklist.note: 三版全图目视未见文字、伪文字、签名、题字；画面没有纸张、书籍、标牌或旗帜。铠甲锚形徽记及冠形装饰为图案。

checklist.requirement: 史诗厚涂：写实成人比例、体积光、大面积暗部，不是卡通或平涂
checklist.note: 成人比例，厚涂衣甲、石城与积雪；火盆暖光照亮烟雾、飞灰，暗前景与冷夜空形成层次，无卡通粗描边或平涂。

checklist.requirement: 构图体现权力关系（提示词里的 POWER AND COMPOSITION 一项）
checklist.note: 平视、与平民共同分柴成立，第三版协作关系最好；但王子仍居中放大，铠甲包边、绳结、锚形扣及胸甲装饰仍有金色，未满足王冠为唯一金色。

checklist.requirement: 光照符合提示词：人造永昼只出现在提示词要求的画面里；冥火青绿只出现在亡灵身上
checklist.note: 三版均为自然星夜与零散暖灯、火盆；未见天空光环或第二太阳。微弱青绿仅源自王子的眼部与紧邻头部的魂火，平民没有青绿发光。

checklist.requirement: 人物身份与参考一致（王子在观众看来的右半边脸是骷髅，金冠断裂）
checklist.note: 紫披风、棕发、甲胄与冠可辨，但三版观众右侧只有额头/眼眶局部骨化，口唇、下颌仍偏人脸或受转头遮挡；参考中的露齿骷髅半脸未完整呈现，断冠缺口也不清楚。
三版目视未见多余手脚。近景递柴与接柴手臂关系可辨；远景群众和受遮挡肢体不作自动解剖保证。

limitations: 骷髅半脸、断冠细节不达标。
额外金色甲饰不符合王冠是唯一金色。
